Not every text you get requires a super hands-on reply, and that’s exactly why automated Smart Replies can be so handy — but for those circumstances where you’d still prefer a bit more of a personal touch, Google looks like’s it’s now preparing a useful Smart Reply upgrade. APK teardown: This reporting is based on work-in-progress code. These features may not ship. Google’s been helping us draft quick responses with Smart Replies for years now, and a few months back even started bringing us a much-needed enhancement, letting us edit Smart Reply drafts with a tap before sending.
